groups.definition: Varying country-by-country government certification and regulatory requirements for emissions, EVs, AVs, connected services and safety increase compliance complexity and cost.

groups.canonical_name: Emissions and fuel economy regulation costs
groups.definition: Changing emissions and fuel economy regulations may require costly credit purchases or penalties, limit profitable ICE sales, and shift EV demand.
Alleged violations of fuel economy and emissions rules could result in fines, recalls, restricted offerings or facility idling.
Dependence on high-margin full-size ICE trucks and SUVs exposes profits to oil price spikes and fuel economy rules.
Rapid technological change and larger competitors may render products obsolete and erode prices while R&D costs rise.
Start-ups and technology entrants in EVs, AVs, software and ridesharing may disrupt the company's core business.
